name: v4.10.0
body:
Two new homes for Ponytail. The headline: native Cursor support through `hooks.json`, with a `scripts/cursor-hooks.js install` that merges into your existing Cursor hooks file and leaves everything else in it alone. Also new: a Grok Build skills adapter, VS Code Copilot is finally detected correctly (no more Claude Code statusline nudge there), and the Claude.ai marketplace validator accepts the plugin again.

## What's Changed
* fix: drop commandWindows from hooks.json for Claude.ai marketplace validation (#593) by @prayag0one4 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/601
* fix: detect VS Code Copilot via CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT fallback (#528) by @krishrathi1 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/579
* feat: add Grok Build native skills adapter (revive #561) by @p-clements in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/661
* docs: add Trendshift badge to READMEs by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/801
* docs: add Trendshift monthly ranking badge by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/802
* docs: put daily, weekly and monthly Trendshift badges in one row by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/803
* docs: Built with Ponytail, Retriever by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/830
* feat: add native Cursor hooks via hooks.json (#817) by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/869

## New Contributors
* @prayag0one4 made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/601
* @p-clements made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/661

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/compare/v4.9.0...v4.10.0
